Extension: R5: The article or artifact being described (new)

Official URL: http://hl7.org/fhir/5.0/StructureDefinition/extension-Citation.citedArtifact Version: 0.1.0
Standards status: Trial-use Active as of 2026-03-04 Maturity Level: 0 Computable Name: ExtensionCitation_CitedArtifact

R5: Citation.citedArtifact (new:BackboneElement)

Context of Use

    This extension may be used on the following element(s)

    • Element ID: Basic

    This extension is allowed for use with FHIR versions R4 to R4 .

Usage info

Usages:

  • Use this Extension: Cross-version Profile for R5.Citation for use in FHIR R4

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics
